line: The lighthouse goes dark; a girl carries the last flame through a night forest and up the storm cliffs.
line_cn: 灯塔熄灭，孙女提着最后一簇火穿过夜林、爬上风暴悬崖。

camera.expresses: Preciousness, a whole place as a map
camera.serves: where we are; scale; a landmark
a conversation; a handover; a choice

transitions: Transitions: short fades to black or cuts between sets;
labels: An inscriptional capital serif (Cinzel, wide tracking) for chapter labels and titles; an old-style serif (Cormorant, Cormorant Garamond italic) for subtitles, dialogue, taglines. All OFL.
Narration subtitles: italic serif ~46–54 px, centred low on a soft dark gradient band, one line per voice clip, in ~0.35 s before the voice.

On-screen speech gets a dialogue box, not a subtitle: dark plate, thin metal border, corner ornaments, name plate on its top edge, text typed over ~90 % of the voice, blinking caret, soft chime on entry.
Chapter cards and a title card belong to the grammar. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s). Export the .srt from the data that drives the overlay.
motion: Sprites step, everything else glides. Walk cycles 4 frames at 6–10 fps, idles alternate two frames at ~1–2 Hz, blinks every few seconds, pose changes are instant cuts between drawings. Camera, lights, particles, beams and focus update every output frame (60 fps).
Poses are data: a parameter object per drawing; a new pose is a new table entry.

Lights breathe: every flame flickers (a few summed sines, about ±20 %). A light's level is one value that drives the sprite drawing, the point light (intensity ∝ level^~1.3), the glow opacity and its scale together.
Weather is procedural: slanted rain streaks; lightning as a scripted flash curve (strike, dip, re-strike, decay) lifting sky, fill and exposure together.

native_moves.name: Shadows jump when a light is lit
native_moves.does: A practical turns on next to sprites and their shadows swing across the floor.
native_moves.fits: a shop opening at dawn; a server rack powering up; a teacher switching on a projector.

native_moves.name: The carried light as a meter
native_moves.does: One small light a character carries is key light and gauge at once: its brightness rises and falls with whatever the story is measuring.
native_moves.fits: a phone battery on a long trip; a patient's heart monitor; a candle vigil.

native_moves.name: Tilt-shift preciousness
native_moves.does: An extra-wide with the band on one tiny subject.
native_moves.fits: a single delivery van in a city; a newborn's room in a whole hospital; one stall in a night market.

native_moves.name: Lights popping on one by one
native_moves.does: Windows, lamps or boats light up at a steady cadence across the map.
native_moves.fits: users joining a network; a village getting electricity; a festival beginning.

native_moves.name: RPG grammar
native_moves.does: Chapter card, named character in a dialogue box, biomes, a landmark, a title card.
native_moves.fits: onboarding a new employee; a history in eras; a recipe in stages.

native_moves.name: Weather passes over the diorama
native_moves.does: Rain, snow or lightning sweeps the tabletop with the flash curve.
native_moves.fits: a market crash; a harvest threatened; a hard week at work.

score.note: chamber fantasy: harp, strings, horns, timpani
